reuse.why: Extends the existing per-provider guard (assertBankAccountNotLinked) rather than adding new checks, and reuses the unlink field-clearing by extracting it into clearAccountBankLink shared with unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The unlink field reset is factored into one helper used by both unlinkAccount and the takeover path; the six provider link functions only pass the flag through.

placement.why: The takeover rule lives in the single guard in accounts/app.ts that every provider link path already calls, and the flag sits on the shared LinkAccountBaseParams type.

scope.why: Limited to the flag, the guard, the extracted helper and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear single point for the rule; the guard now mutates state under a validation-like name position (it runs before the link itself), which is slightly surprising but documented.
